newsitem.title: USA: U.S. LPGs steady to higher on strong NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. LPGs steady to higher on strong NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady to higher in quiet late trade on Monday amid firmer NYMEX futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held onto its one cent intraday gain, remaining between 49.00 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon.
Spot material in the Midwest also held on to its 0.75 cent gain in earlier trade, remaining 49.00/49.25 cents in quiet activity.
Traders said both markets found support in NYMEX November crude oil futures, which ended up 96 cents at $25.62 a barrel.
NYMEX November gasoline futures led the charge for Belvieu natural gasoline, which rose one cent to 56.00/58.00 cents. Conway material held steady at 54.50/55.00 cents, traders said.
Meanwhile, Belvieu purity ethane traded for 30.88 cents, nearly a quarter cent higher than at midday.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
